Notes: (1) Separate register should be maintained for adult/child.
(2) A child shall include an adolescent worker who has not been certified fit to work as an adult
(3) A separate page should be maintained in respect of each worker.
(4) Leave earned in column (14) is calculated on the basis of number of days worked given in column (9)
(5) As per section 79(5), figures in column (16) should not exceed 30 days in case of adult and 40 days in case of child worker.
